designation of the two figures as guardians of the door

items.question: What form and placement must the two door guardians have?
premises: The two figures stand at the door.
The two figures function as door guardians.
They must be fashioned in spirit form.
They must be fashioned with two arms.
items.inference: The door guardians are to be made as two-armed, spirit-formed figures stationed at the door.
items.plain_english: The two door guardians, standing at the door, should be made in spirit form with two arms.
